Claude's reply now comes out a block at a time in the terminal instead of a few lines every tenth of a second (`replyInBlocks`, on by default).

- The text before a tool call comes out with the call, and the answer at the end of a turn comes out whole; while it waits, the spinner shows how many lines it holds
- A block taller than about 60% of the screen comes out a screenful at a time at a paragraph or line break, so its start stays on screen, and `⋯ gathering the rest` sits in the band until the last part is out
- Pressing Esc still shows what was held
- When your last prompt came from the Claude app (Remote Control), the reply streams as usual: the app receives the same stream and draws it smoothly on its own
- `replyInBlocks: off` in `/config` streams as Claude Code does

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
